name: sofia
description: Sofia — English translations of classical Greek and Latin texts, side by side with the original.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n site,api,editor -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @sofia/site dev" "pnpm --filter @sofia/editor-server dev" "pnpm --filter @sofia/editor dev"
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name sofia-translations --branch main --commit-dirty=true
